"""Fixture for the vaultwrite lint (T2.4): a vault-md write OUTSIDE the
applier. The .py.txt suffix keeps it out of the tree check; the selfcheck
copies it as real .py and proves the grep still fires."""

def bad_append(vault_day_path: str, text: str) -> None:
    with open(vault_day_path, "a") as f:  # VIOLATION: vault write outside staged_writebacks
        f.write(text + "\n")
